blogui.index_title: Asferia Adventure Journal — East Kazakhstan, the Altai and Freeride in Ridder
blogui.index_desc: Guides to East Kazakhstan: freeride and cat skiing in Ridder, winter in the Kazakh Altai, Katon-Karagay National Park, itineraries and practical planning.
blogui.index_sub: Winter and summer in East Kazakhstan: where to go, how to get there and what to know before you arrive.

winter.p: From 10 December near Ridder. Snowcat from 60,000 KZT, snowmobiles from 80,000 KZT per person.

freeride.p: Snowmobile or snowcat drop-offs. Tours of 3 riding days and 4 nights from 370,000 KZT.

summer.p: Jeep day trips from Ridder, multi-day trips and tailor-made journeys across East Kazakhstan.

home.p: Route, vehicles, guides, hotels and permits — we arrange the whole trip.
